game.title: Yakuza Kiwami
game.blurb: Action-adventure brawler with RPG growth, set in Kamurocho, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2016-01-21. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG, Fighting. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Kiryu's return and the story, chapter by chapter. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden on Steam.

chapters.title: Majima Everywhere
chapters.summary: Being chased and ambushed by Majima in his many forms, ranking up and the Majima-themed hidden goals.

chapters.title: Substories and City Life
chapters.summary: Substories, the Completion List, hostesses, dates and walking with Haruka in Premium Adventure.

chapters.title: Minigames and the Coliseum
chapters.summary: Pocket Circuit, MesuKing, mahjong, every minigame and the underground coliseum tournaments.

chapters.title: Fighting Styles and Abilities
chapters.summary: Soul, Technique and Body abilities and the Komaki Style training.

chapters.title: Legend and Final Challenges
chapters.summary: The overall completion goal and the hidden Amon and Dragon of Legend goals.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3717330)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Yakuza_Kiwami
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Yakuza_Kiwami
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Steam app 3717330 is listed in the Steam store list as "Yakuza Kiwami"; its schema calls the app "NEXUS2_K1" (an internal codename). It is the only Yakuza Kiwami entry in the Steam app list that was fetched. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, with 15 subpages. Of its chapter pages only "Chapter 1" (about 2,900 characters), "Chapter 3" (about 2,900) and "Finale" (about 2,500) exist; Chapters 2 and 4 to 12 are linked but not created. Reference pages are better: "Abilities" (about 22,800), "Achievements and trophies" (about 10,100), "Completion List" (about 6,500), "Eateries" (about 6,500), "Stores" (about 5,800), "Goro Majima Everywhere" (about 1,900), "Substories" (about 1,400) and "Minigames" (about 1,200). The walkthrough is too thin to use, so nothing was taken. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API, with about 57 linked pages, including "Yakuza Kiwami/Chapter 1" to "Chapter 13", "Majima Everywhere" and "Pocket Circuit Racing"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 30 of 55 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Hidden 26 to 39 are named like story beats and sit in the main story chapter. Five hidden ones named after Majima or "Goromi" were placed in Majima Everywhere by name. "Dragon of Legend" (hidden, 2.9%) was placed with the end-game goals by name; in the Kiwami 2 schema an achievement with the same name means finishing on Legend mode, but this schema gives no description. "Amon Defeated" also sits there. The other hidden ones ("You'll Only Get Burned", "That's a Man!", "Sonic Right Hook", "An Answer Owed", "Kidney Stones", "A Bad Business", "She's Worth It?", "Death By Climax", "Mister Master") have low unlock rates and are probably side goals, but nothing says what they are, so they sit in the main story chapter as placeholders.
